messages:
eli_sales: Heads-up: NovaApps POC hit missing trace links in Console and noisy 429s during a bulk demo. Can we triage quickly? :warning:

mike_se: on it. Do we have a sample request + their forwarder logs? Even one example will tell if header is lost before export.

eli_sales: pasted (redacted):
```
POST /v1/complete 200
Headers: { Authorization: Bearer REDACTED, X-Trace-Id: aa11bb22, traceparent: 00-aa11bb22xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx-01 }
Client log:
[2026-03-20T16:20:11Z] WARN status=429 reason=rate_limit request_id=rc_456 trace=aa11bb22
[2026-03-20T16:20:12Z] INFO forwarder: sent to hec status=ok trace=
```

mike_se: pattern looks like header present to our gateway but HEC events sometimes arrive without trace field. Two possibilities: (1) export pipeline didn't set metadata.trace_id, or (2) their forwarder strips headers/samples.

devon_sre: I can check our exporter logs for events missing metadata.trace_id and inspect the Splunk drain connector sampling rules. I can also temporarily bump the POC token qps to avoid 429s during demo. Need short approval.

eli_sales: I can approve a 15-minute increase. Demo is in 45 minutes.

devon_sre: done  raised qps to 5rps for org=novaapps for 15m and enabled debug export logging for that org.
deploy-bot: runtime update: poc-qps-bump -> org-novaapps (owner: devon_sre). Canary: 5% traffic.
deploy-bot: canary OK. Change rolled to 100%.

mike_se: pushed a small canary to set event.metadata.trace_id from headers in this order: metadata.trace_id || X-Trace-Id || traceparent (extract id). Deploying to p-prod-canary.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: export-set-traceid v0.3.0 -> p-prod-canary (owner: mike_se)
deploy-bot: canary health: 9/9 checks passed, 2% traffic routed.

mike_se: verified on canary: exported events now include metadata.trace_id=aa11bb22 and Splunk HEC shows matching ids.

amber_security: security note: confirm their Splunk HEC endpoint uses TLS and the HEC token is scoped to ingest-only. Also record the temporary qps bump approval in security logs.

eli_sales: NovaApps confirmed TLS + ingest-only token and accepted 15m bump. I'll send them a short runbook.

mike_se: runbook snippet to send:
1) Ensure forwarder preserves headers or writes trace_id into event.metadata.trace_id.
2) Create a Splunk HEC drain with map_trace_id=metadata.trace_id. Example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/drains \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <org-token>\" \
  -d '{"type":"splunk_hec","url":"https://splunk.novaapps:8088/services/collector","token":"HEC_TOKEN","map_trace_id":"metadata.trace_id"}'
```
3) For POC fidelity optionally set trace_sampling: full (warn: increases export volume).

eli_sales: scheduling a 10-min call with NovaApps ops now to walk through the runbook. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
